title: US zoo staff monitor Fiona the hippo’s rear end for signs of hat she ate
summary_full: Colonoscopy, ultrasound, Vibration plate and patience deployed 11 days after beloved beast ingested knitted hatFiona the hippo, one of America’s most famous zoo animals, has undergone a colonoscopy amid efforts to remove a knitted hat which she swallowed after it fell into her enclosure.With surgery too risky for a full-grown hippos like Fiona, who weighs in the region of 2,500 pounds (1,113kg), veterinarians tried an alternative method of getting the hat to pass through her system.
